correctness.rationale: A group-overwrite event has mutant count increment b when chosen by one of a mutant parents, and -a for one of b resident parents, giving exact potential drift r^(-i)/(dZ)∑_e [ra(r^(-b)-1)+b(r^a-1)]. For mixed a,b>=1 with a+b>=3, G(1)=G’(1)=0 and G’’(r)=ab[(b-1)r^(-b-1)+(a-1)r^(a-2)]>0. Connectivity ensures at least one mixed edge, giving strict bounded submartingale of r^-I for r!=1. Finite connected chain has absorption a.s.; optional stopping yields strict Moran sign with correct denominator reversal for r<1. At r=1 count is a martingale, pairwise |e|=2 gives G identically zero. Independent rational mixed-edge drift and 4-vertex complete-triple fixation checks agree. This proof is correct despite prior coverage.
residual_risks: No claim for irregular incidence, mixed 2/3-edge structures, focal imitation, or majority-conditioned updates.
